summary: Sprint 2a entitlement / paywall backend gating verified. Added /app/backend/tests/test_entitlements.py with 18 tests covering auth guards, free defaults on new users, mock unlock (annual + monthly + default product), downgrade/clear, persistence across GET, /auth/me entitlement surface, backward-compat with legacy Mongo docs (no entitlement fields), expiry logic, active-trial fallback, and legacy endpoint regression. Full suite: 38/38 pass (18 new + 20 Sprint 1 regression). No modifications to server.py — only test additions. No _id leaks observed in any entitlement response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1120 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider modularizing (auth/, entitlements/, journal/, dashboard/) in a future refactor. Not blocking for Sprint 2a.

MockEntitlementRequest.product is Optional[str] with no server-side validation of allowed values. Currently accepts any product string. Consider Literal['pl_premium_monthly','pl_premium_annual'] or a whitelist check before wiring real IAP.

/api/entitlement/mock has no rate limiting or dev-only guard. Since spec calls it a 'dev endpoint', consider gating behind an env flag (e.g. ALLOW_MOCK_ENTITLEMENT) before shipping to prod so users cannot self-unlock premium via the public API.
_entitlement_is_active correctly handles TZ-naive datetimes coming back from Mongo — good defensive coding.
User model uses Pydantic v2 defaults for new entitlement fields, so legacy Mongo docs deserialize cleanly (verified by TestEntitlementBackwardCompat).
seed_data_creation: Per-test ephemeral Mongo user rows keyed on random UUID subs, each cleaned up in a try/finally teardown. QA_SUB shared fixture continues to be wiped by conftest.wipe_qa_data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2a is green end-to-end on the backend. When Sprint 2b (real RevenueCat / Stripe webhook sync) lands, add tests for: (a) webhook signature validation, (b) idempotency on repeated webhook deliveries, (c) product-to-entitlement mapping, (d) removal / disabling of /api/entitlement/mock (or its env-flag gate). Also revisit MockEntitlementRequest.product validation and consider Literal-typing it. UI paywall gating (Sanctuary paywall screen) was NOT tested — request UI review when frontend work is ready.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all tests pass. One transient test-authoring bug in the annual-unlock assertion (naive vs aware datetime subtraction) was fixed in-place; not an app issue.
